fact: Invest Salone's brief says the Startup Act is currently in development, intended to recognise startups as a distinct business class with tax incentives for certified angel investments.
The communications minister said on 12 September 2026 that the government plans a Startup Act, expected in the first quarter of 2027, and an Innovation Investment Fund.
The communications ministry and the International Trade Centre held a validation workshop on a startup ecosystem policy, meant to feed the planned Startup Act, in September 2026.
